description:
Export a finished validation or scoring file back to the connected Amazon S3 bucket.
When to use: When the user wants results written to their S3 bucket.
Parameters: fileId — the finished job's file id; exportBucket (optional) — defaults to the bucket in the account's S3 settings.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.

exportBucket.description: Destination bucket. Optional: without it the output bucket configured on your ZeroBounce account is used.

fileId.description: File ID of the completed bulk job

name: export_s3file
title: Export results to Amazon S3
